title: 第102章 他就是朕的小诗仙！
novel_title: 唐逸孔诗岚大结局全文免费阅读
content_zh: 唐音缺少父爱，但她却从不奢求唐敬的父爱。　　不过，她对萧策这陌生的大叔却极为喜欢，所以见到炎文帝，她第一时间就选择告状，让炎文帝帮唐逸。　　唐逸见到这一幕，顿时有些尴尬，他也完全没想到唐音见到萧策的第一件事，竟然是告状。　　这真不是他的主意啊！　　而且她这可怜兮兮的样子，哪个男人顶得住？　　果然炎文帝听到唐音的话，原本温和的脸色瞬间阴沉下来，谁给孩子说这些乱七八糟的？　　炎文帝将唐音抱了起来，只能和唐逸一样，随意编了一个理由：“青楼，是喝茶的地方。”　　总不能说青楼是男人寻欢作乐的地方吧？　　孩子还这么小，这不是毒害孩子吗？　　结果，唐音眨了眨眼睛，又道：“可是，刘州哥哥不是说青楼是玩女人的地方吗？”　　炎文帝脚下一个趔趄，险些一头栽倒。　　原本僵硬的脸，此时乌云密布，阴沉得可怕：“刘州？谁是刘州？哪个是刘州，给朕滚出来！”　　刘州吓得直接趴在了地上，这些话都是他刚才为了羞辱和激怒唐逸，故意说给唐音听的。　　他爹是户部尚书，他说几句不得体的话怎么了？谁特妈敢有意见。　　可现在皇帝有意见！　　“陛下饶命，陛下饶命……”　　刘州当即爬了出来，跪在地上磕头如捣蒜。　　唐逸他能轻松拿捏，想怎么收拾他就怎么收拾他。　　现在风水轮流转，炎文帝想怎么灭他就怎么灭他。　　他可不想死，当即使出了杀手锏……搬出老子！　　“陛下，别杀我，别杀我，我爹是户部尚书刘温。”　　“陛下，我爹是你的左膀右臂啊！”　　唐逸闻言下意识地看向不远处的刘温，发现刚才嚣张跋扈的老小子现在也是抖若筛糠，显然被他的大孝子给孝到了。　　哈哈，这叫什么？这就叫在线坑爹啊！　　“哦？你爹是刘温？”炎文帝眼睛眯了起来，脸色凛冽。　　站在炎文帝身边的太傅孔明箴老脸下意识抽了抽，呵呵，陛下你是个会演的，刘州的父亲是谁你不知道吗？　　你都悄咪咪的在暗处，看了半炷香的热闹了好吧！　　“陛下，臣刘温管教不严，陛下恕罪。”　　刘温也赶紧爬了出来，连连磕头，　　要搁在平时，面对炎文帝他也能争上两三分。　　可现在不同，就算他是丞相一党的核心人物之一，也不敢当众冒犯天颜啊！　　想到这些刘温恨不得跳起来将儿子打死，蠢货，早知道你这么坑爹，当初老子就该打在墙上，就不该将你生下来！　　皇帝正愁着没理由搞掉你爹呢，现在有了。　　你不仅给了皇帝理由，你还直接递刀子！　　现在想要保命，必须得为刘州找个正当的理由。　　而突破口，就是唐逸！　　想到这些，刘温猛地指向唐逸，大声道：“陛下，都是他的错，都是他！”　　“陛下，犬子出言不逊，是因为被他激怒，才口不择言的。”　　“陛下，唐逸才是罪魁祸首，他不仅冒充小诗仙，他还购买诗词企图染指沈园诗会。”　　唐逸一听差点忍不住拔刀，当场将这老家伙给砍了。　　这也能让我背锅？　　我这不说话，你还真当我是背锅侠了是吧？　　不过老家伙，你的如意算盘虽然打得很响，但皇帝知道我的身份，你这时候还想着将我推出来挡灾，那是自寻死路啊！　　唐逸目光落在炎文帝的身上，就看到炎文帝嘴角的笑容变得戏谑起来。　　他没有理会刘温的指控，而是看向了唐敬：“哦？是这样吗？唐侍郎？”　　“刘尚书是否有冤枉你儿子？想清楚了再回答！”　　后面的话，炎文帝明显咬得有些重。　　唐敬身体微微一僵，他自然听得出皇帝的意思，这是在责怪他这个当爹的，刚才没有为唐逸说话。　　但这都是那蠢货自己惹的祸，凭什么要我搭上唐家的荣誉为他买单？　　唐家今日出现在沈园，是来享受掌声和恭维的，不是来演杂耍的。　　唐逸那废物已经将唐家的脸面丢光了，还想要我帮他说话？　　“回陛下，刘尚书所言属实，的确是犬子有错在先，才导致事情失控的。”　　“望陛下开恩，莫要责罚刘尚书。”　　唐敬可不想因为唐逸这唐家败类，和刘温彻底交恶。　　况且，刘温说的也是事实。　　事实就是唐逸冒充小诗仙，大言不惭挑衅全场！　　炎文帝听到这话，眼中有失望一闪而过，但很快脸色便激动起来，嘴角露出和煦的笑容。　　哈哈，唐敬啊唐敬，朕给过你机会了的，是你自己不珍惜的。　　那你这儿子，以后就只是朕的儿子了……嗯，女婿也算半个儿！　　炎文帝相信，今日之事将永远成为唐逸心中的刺，以后……嘿，以后朕等着看你唐敬追儿子火葬场。　　咳咳，忍住，不能开心得太明显。　　唐敬看着炎文帝快要咧到耳边的嘴角，整个人当时都有些懵了。　　咋回事？怎么感觉皇帝知道真相后，不仅没生气，反而更加的开心了？　　错觉，一定是错觉！　　还是说，陛下对我的回答很满意？　　心头这么想，但不知为何唐敬忽然升起浓浓的不安，总感觉要出事。　　唐逸看到炎文帝的笑容，心头也是一阵发凉，这笑容太阴险，有阴谋啊！　　不知为何他忽然想到了萧棣的警告：不要相信我爹所说的任何一个字。　　难道，皇帝温文尔雅的样子，是骗人的？　　“唐逸，你怎么说？”炎文帝的声音传来。　　唐逸思绪立即回笼，怎么说？你不觉得你这话问得有点多余吗？　　“回陛下，臣只是实话实说。”唐逸拱手说道。　　“父皇，我可以作证，是他们一群人，欺负唐逸一个人。”　　萧棣抬头，拱手附和。　　他不爽唐敬刘温这群人很久了，明明就是他们挑事在先，现在竟然想颠倒黑白，让唐逸背锅？　　想得美！　　“四弟，不可胡说。”　　太子又岂会错过这种拉拢大臣的机会，他当即看向炎文帝，道：“陛下，儿臣已经在这里看了半天了，的确是唐逸有错在先。”　　“儿臣知道父皇看重小诗仙，而唐逸竟然公然假冒小诗仙，才引起众人的反感，望父皇明察。”　　炎文帝看了太子一眼，眼中忽然有点怜悯了。　　朕给你这么久的时间，让你去调查唐逸，审查唐逸，拉拢唐逸……　　结果，你就给朕这么一份答卷？　　废物！　　从来只会被这群文官玩得团团转！　　以后江山交到你手里，你不得被这群大臣捏着脖子？！　　“谁说，他是冒充的？”　　“他，就是朕的小诗仙！”　　炎文帝指着唐逸，淡然一笑。　　他声音平静，却宛若惊雷，席卷全场。
content_en: Tang Yin lacked father's love, but she never expected Tang Jing's father's love.However, she was very fond of Xiao Ce, a strange uncle, so when she saw Emperor Yanwen, she immediately chose to file a complaint and ask Emperor Yanwen to help Tang Yi.Tang Yi felt a little embarrassed when he saw this scene. He also didn't expect that the first thing Tang Yin did when he saw Xiao Ce was to complain.This really wasn’t his idea!And what man can stand up to her pitiful appearance?Sure enough, when Emperor Yanwen heard Tang Yin's words, his originally gentle face instantly darkened. Who told the child such nonsense?Emperor Yanwen picked up Tang Yin, and like Tang Yi, he could only make up a random reason: "A brothel is a place to drink tea." You can't say that a brothel is a place for men to have fun, right?The child is still so young. Isn’t this poisoning the child?As a result, Tang Yin blinked and said, "But didn't brother Liu Zhou say that brothels are places for playing with women?" Emperor Yan Wen staggered and almost fell down.The originally stiff face was now covered with dark clouds, and it was terrifyingly gloomy: "Liu Zhou? Who is Liu Zhou? Which one is Liu Zhou? Get out of here!" Liu Zhou was so frightened that he fell to the ground. These words he just said to Tang Yin deliberately in order to humiliate and anger Tang Yi.His father is the Minister of Household Affairs. What happened to him saying a few inappropriate words?Who dares to have an opinion?But now the emperor has an opinion!"Your Majesty, spare your life, Your Majesty, spare your life..." Liu Zhou immediately crawled out, knelt on the ground and kowtowed as if pounding garlic.He can handle Tang Yi easily and deal with him as he wants.Now that things are changing, Emperor Yanwen can destroy him however he wants.He didn’t want to die, so he immediately found his trump card...move me out!"Your Majesty, don't kill me, don't kill me. My father is Liu Wen, the Minister of the Ministry of Revenue." "Your Majesty, my father is your right-hand man!" Upon hearing this, Tang Yi subconsciously looked at Liu Wen not far away, and found that the arrogant and domineering old boy was now shaking like chaff. He was obviously filial to his filial son.Haha, what is this called?This is called online cheating!"Oh? Your father is Liu Wen?" Emperor Yanwen narrowed his eyes and his face was stern.Grand Tutor Kong Mingzhen, who was standing next to Emperor Yanwen, subconsciously twitched his face. Haha, Your Majesty, you are an actor. Don’t you know who Liu Zhou’s father is?You've been quietly watching the excitement of half a stick of incense in the dark, okay?"Your Majesty, your Majesty, Liu Wen is not strict in discipline. Your Majesty forgives me." Liu Wen also climbed out quickly and kowtowed repeatedly. In normal times, he could compete with Emperor Yanwen by two or three points.But it’s different now. Even if he is one of the core figures of the Prime Minister’s party, he would not dare to offend Tianyan in public!Thinking of this, Liu Wen wanted to jump up and beat his son to death. Idiot, if I had known you were such a cheater, I should have punched you against the wall in the first place, and I shouldn't have given birth to you!The emperor was worried that there was no reason to get rid of your father, and now he has.Not only did you give the emperor a reason, you also directly handed him the knife!If you want to save your life now, you must find a legitimate reason for Liu Zhou.The breakthrough point is Tang Yi!Thinking of this, Liu Wen pointed at Tang Yi and said loudly: "Your Majesty, it's all his fault, it's all him!" "Your Majesty, Quanzi said something rude because he was provoked by him, so he said what he said." "Your Majesty, Tang Yi is the culprit. Not only did he pretend to be a little poetry fairy, he also bought poems in an attempt to get involved in the Shenyuan Poetry Club." Tang Yi almost couldn't help but draw his knife and cut the old guy on the spot.Does this also allow me to take the blame?If I don’t say anything, you really think I’m the scapegoat, right?But old guy, although your wishful thinking is very loud, the emperor knows my identity. If you still want to push me out to prevent disaster, you are asking for death!Tang Yi's eyes fell on Emperor Yanwen, and he saw the smile on the corner of Emperor Yanwen's mouth turn playful.He ignored Liu Wen's accusation and looked at Tang Jing: "Oh? Is that so? Tang Shilang?" "Did Liu Shangshu wrong your son? Think carefully before answering!" In the following words, Emperor Yanwen obviously bit hard.Tang Jing's body stiffened slightly. He could naturally hear what the emperor meant. He was blaming him as a father for not speaking up for Tang Yi just now.But this is all the trouble caused by the fool himself. Why should I take advantage of the honor of the Tang family to pay for him?The Tang family came to Shen Yuan today to enjoy the applause and compliments, not to perform sideshows.That good-for-nothing Tang Yi has already disgraced the Tang family, and he still wants me to speak for him?"Your Majesty, what Liu Shangshu said is true. It was indeed the dog's fault that caused things to get out of control." "I hope your majesty will be merciful and don't punish Liu Shangshu." Tang Jing did not want to completely turn against Liu Wen because of Tang Yi, a scum of the Tang family.Besides, what Liu Wen said is also true.The fact is that Tang Yi pretended to be a little poetry fairy and made bold remarks to provoke the whole audience!When Emperor Yan Wen heard this, disappointment flashed across his eyes, but soon his face became excited, and a warm smile appeared at the corner of his mouth.Haha, Tang Jing, Tang Jing, I gave you a chance, but you didn’t cherish it.Then your son will only be my son from now on... Well, my son-in-law can also be considered half a son!Emperor Yanwen believes that what happened today will always be a thorn in Tang Yi's heart. In the future... Hey, I'll wait to see you Tang Jingchui's son's crematorium in the future.Ahem, hold it in, don’t be too obviously happy.Tang Jing looked at Emperor Yanwen's grin that was about to reach his ears, and he was a little confused at the time.What's going on?Why do you feel that after the emperor knew the truth, not only was he not angry, but he was even happier?Illusion, it must be an illusion!Or are you satisfied with my answer?He thought so, but for some reason Tang Jing suddenly felt uneasy, feeling that something was going to happen.Tang Yi felt chilled when he saw Emperor Yanwen's smile. This smile was too insidious and there was a conspiracy!For some reason, he suddenly thought of Xiao Di's warning: Don't believe a word my father said.Could it be that the emperor's gentle appearance was a lie?"Tang Yi, what do you say?" Emperor Yanwen's voice came.Tang Yi's thoughts immediately returned, what should I say?Don't you think your question is a bit redundant?"Return to your majesty, my lord.
title_en: Chapter 102 He is my little poetry fairy!
